sources.authority: Primary design identity and frontage cadence. One occupied floor; long glazed park-facing frontage; six outer veranda columns on brick pedestals with knee braces; recessed glazing-line supports; main public double entry toward the left and secondary glazed exit toward the right; cedar ends and low planting/bicycle approach. Trace the projected individual members rather than inferring an evenly spaced seven-post row.

Corroborates the continuous front veranda, exposed right gable, right-end three narrow windows, timber framing/brick pedestal relationships and front-to-back roof arrangement. The front view remains primary for facade placement.

Topology corroboration only: one rectangular common roof with two pitched planes meeting one continuous long ridge parallel to the front, extending forward over the veranda. No extra rear bar, roofbox, dormer or valley. Still elevated oblique rather than requested near-nadir; not metric footprint, bay spacing or hidden rear-fenestration authority.

roof_graph.body: One rectangular single-storey enclosed hall, with an open veranda across its park-facing long edge.
roof_graph.ridge: One continuous ridge parallel to the glazed long front.
roof_graph.planes: One rear slope and one forward slope. Forward roof continues above the veranda and its outer support row.
roof_graph.ends: Two cedar gable ends under the common roof; no intersecting wing or separate veranda roof volume.
roof_graph.lines: Standing seams, ridge/eave trim and front slope snow-retention lines are surface hardware, not additional ridges or folds.
roof_graph.rear: Rear wall belongs beneath the same rear eave. Its exact fenestration and dimensions remain inferred.

column_count_reconciliation.explanation: The apparent seventh column results from counting a recessed timber/brick support at the glazing plane as part of the outer row. In front001 the right support near x1502 is behind the outer row; the entrance/glazing line also has additional brick-based supports. In oblique001 the apparent extra near x239 is recessed. Top002's six outer supports therefore do not constitute a six-versus-seven contradiction.
column_count_reconciliation.limits: Approximate image x coordinates identify visible members, not metric spacing. Do not author seven evenly spaced outer columns from the total count of all visible pedestals. Recessed glazing-plane supports must be classified separately.

remaining_inferences: Exact 32 x 22 m interpretation: whether depth includes the veranda, enclosed depth, veranda depth and roof overhangs must be stated before construction.
Eave/ridge heights, slope, member sizes, pedestal dimensions, support spacing and exact roof-to-frame contacts.
Complete internal glulam frame arrangement and roof lining; visible references do not prove a load-path calculation.
Multipurpose, smaller meeting rooms, kitchen, storage and toilets, with their partitions, fixtures, private/public entries and window-carrier relationships.
Rear and obscured side fenestration, mechanical/service details, drainage and landscape extent.
Grounded public approach, porch edge/threshold transitions, authored walking network and actual-GLB clearances.

material_contract.cedar: Cedar v002 is category-compatible, raw seamless repeat held. Individual .12m boards with .004m joints own cladding morphology. Each board maps only the interior .06..94 fraction of one of eight source board faces. Each complete board height fits one source interval; no horizontal or vertical raw texture wrapping.
material_contract.mapping: Wall texture .96x2.40m authority. Local B.uv_all wrapper explicitly precompensates shared tile scaling, then maps board-local coordinate axes. No shared compiler/delivery edits.
material_contract.plinth: Physical .24x.075m red-brown brick courses over mortar carrier and pedestal bases. Individual brick solids are consolidated in one mesh without per-brick bevel operations; morphology/positions remain explicit geometry. Sharp edges and prototype palette finish remain keeper limitations. All brick solids are clipped in both horizontal and vertical axes against every intersecting aperture, including front windows beginning z.20. The consolidated envelope mesh is not used as a giant native obstacle.
material_contract.limits: Strong cedar knots, golden hue, fitted vertical grain scaling and short-pattern repetition remain keeper limits. Prototype palette metal/glulam/fixtures, optics and schematic landscape require independent complete review.

circulation_contract.floor: Actual slab height .14m, public path .04m; 1.3m ramp rises .10m (7.69% inferred slope). Plateau y[-14.7,-13.2], ramp y[-16,-14.7], native ramp/plateau/waypoint and portal endpoint agree. Supported real entrance/rear floor strips and bike/bench pads; no code/accessibility certification.
circulation_contract.obligations: Run actual app check-walking, garden probes and exact exported GLB floor/headroom ray verification with unchanged tolerances. Inspect complete routes and doors in browser. Furniture, carriers, supports and leaves must be obstacles.
